pages.text: A Mountaintear is an Arcane Gem formed from an orange-spectrum piece of $(l:arcanearchives:items/shapedquartz)Shaped Radiant Quartz$(/l) in a pendeloque cut.$(br2)When activated, a Mountaintear will conjure a block of lava at a distance of up to 40 blocks at the cost of one point of charge.

Astral Sorcery Lightwell When placed in a Lightwell with access to the sky, a Mountaintear generates lava at a slow rate. While it's possible for a Mountaintear to shatter, the chances of shattering are $()$(italic)astronomically$() unlikely. For all intents and purposes, a Mountaintear lasts indefinitely unless its Lightwell is broken.$(br2)Once placed in a Lightwell, a Mountaintear cannot be retrieved.
Mountaintears can be crafted on a $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/gemcutterstable)Gem Cutter's Table$(/l).
